name: 346. In headers placement a stream error frame after the first chunk keeps extra_fields.error_type (stream error type) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6985, contract C6 (BF8). With client.extra_fields_placement = "headers" every body and SSE chunk loses extra_fields, and its scalar fields go out as x-bifrost-* headers. A stream's headers are written before the first chunk, so when the provider fails after that, x-bifrost-error-type cannot carry the classification; the error frame keeps extra_fields reduced to {"error_type": ...} instead. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: start tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs and the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, and run with providerErrorFixture=1; every row is skipped otherwise. openai/upstream-cut sends the first chunk and then drops the connection, which the gateway reports as provider_connection_failed. [SERIAL]: the folder switches client config that other rows depend on, so the harness runs it alone, in order. It reads the stored client config, switches placement to headers, streams upstream-cut through native /v1/chat/completions and the /openai integration, restores the original placement, checks that body placement keeps the full extra_fields on the same error frame, and verifies the stored value. Red before the change: in headers placement the error frame has no extra_fields at all. Run with FEATURE="stream error type".
